item.title: Green Insurance Guide | Save 75 Euros at the Border and the 90-Day Rule (2026)
item.description:
Green Insurance Guide: We Saved 75 Euros at the Border — Here Are All the Details
#

Overview
#

Hello LebenInsider readers! As Turks considering moving to Germany or already driving on German roads, one of the biggest transitions in our lives is undoubtedly the status of our vehicles and driver’s licenses. Coming to Germany by car from Turkey, especially if it’s your first time, is quite an adventure. One of the most critical starting points of this adventure is Green Insurance, also known as the International Motor Insurance Card. If you plan to come to Europe with your vehicle, it’s legally impossible to set off without this document. So, what is this insurance, why is it so important, and most importantly: how can you prevent unnecessary extra money from leaving your pocket?

item.title: Your Child's Passport to the World: Essential Travel Documents from Germany
item.description: As Turkish families and expats living in Germany, we often find ourselves navigating a beautiful blend of cultures and, of course, a good deal of German bureaucracy. While we love the freedom of travel that comes with living in the heart of Europe, one area that consistently causes stress for us, especially when traveling with children, is the mountain of documents required. I’ve heard countless stories, and experienced a few myself, of families being delayed or even denied boarding because of missing paperwork for their little ones. It’s a situation no one wants to be in, particularly after months of planning that perfect family vacation!
